title: Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Prayagraj) has released the notification for the post of Research Associates. This recruitment has been issued for 36 posts. Online applying process for Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025 has started from 15 March 2025 & the candidates can apply till 01 April 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Prayagraj)

Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025

AHC Advt No. : 01/ Research Associates/2025

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 15 March 2025
  • Last Date : 01 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 April 2025
  • Candidate Shortlisted for Test & Interview : 27 May 2025
  • Exam Date & Interview : July 2025
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Allahabad High Court Research Associates Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 July 2025
  • Minimum Age : 21 Years
  • Maximum Age : 26 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment Rules.

Allahabad High Court Research Associates Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates having Degree in Law (LLB 3 Years / 5 Years) from Any Recognized University in India will be considered for this post.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.allahabadhighcourt.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Allahabad High Court before Last Date.
